# External Factors

`economic_covariates.csv` is the respondent-state/year macroeconomic
table used by the shared model input contract. The ReAct agent can join
it by `itemid` or respondent-state/year in the same way prompted and
structured models can serialize the table.

This module contains external covariates only. It does not contain
targets, claim amounts, Article 41 text, operative clauses, direct award
snippets, predictions, or provider traces.
